name: Enlightenment
summary: You pursue forbidden truth, revelation, or an impossible theory that others fear or dismiss.
recommendationNotes: Best fit for a character trying to prove a hidden logic behind the Vermissian.
Pairs well with concepts about secret texts, predictions, and dangerous experiments.

name: Adventure
summary: You go deeper because danger, discovery, and impossible places call to you.
recommendationNotes: Good fit when the character is motivated by the journey itself rather than a specific truth.
